import sys
import math

epsilon = 1e-8

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def __eq__(self, other):
        if not isinstance(other, Point):
            return False
        return abs(self.x - other.x) <= epsilon and abs(self.y - other.y) <= epsilon

    def __hash__(self):
        # Not used in the algorithm, but for completeness
        return hash((self.x, self.y))

    def distance(self, other):
        return math.hypot(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"({self.x}, {self.y})"

class Line:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c):
        h = math.hypot(a, b)
        self.a = a / h
        self.b = b / h
        self.c = c / h

    @staticmethod
    def from_point_angle(p, angle):
        a = math.sin(angle)
        b = -math.cos(angle)
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b
        return Line(a, b, c)

    def intersect(self, other):
        if self.parallel(other):
            return None
        det = self.b * other.a - self.a * other.b
        x = (self.c * other.b - self.b * other.c) / det
        y = (self.a * other.c - self.c * other.a) / det
        return Point(x, y)

    def parallel(self, other):
        return abs(self.a * other.b - self.b * other.a) < epsilon

    def perpendicular(self, point):
        return Line(-self.b, self.a, self.b * point.x - self.a * point.y)

    def value(self, point):
        return self.a * point.x + self.b * point.y + self.c

    def distance(self, center):
        return abs(self.value(center))

    def intersect_circle(self, circle):
        dist = self.distance(circle.center)
        if dist > circle.radius + epsilon:
            return []
        inter = self.intersect(self.perpendicular(circle.center))
        if inter is None:
            return []
        if abs(dist - circle.radius) < epsilon:
            return [inter]
        shift = math.sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist)
        return [
            Point(inter.x + shift * self.b, inter.y - shift * self.a),
            Point(inter.x - shift * self.b, inter.y + shift * self.a)
        ]

    def __eq__(self, other):
        if not isinstance(other, Line):
            return False
        if not self.parallel(other):
            return False
        return (abs(self.a * other.c - self.c * other.a) <= epsilon and
                abs(self.b * other.c - self.c * other.b) <= epsilon)

class Circle:
    def __init__(self, center, radius):
        self.center = center
        self.radius = radius

    def intersect(self, other):
        dist = self.center.distance(other.center)
        if dist < epsilon:
            return None
        a = 2 * (other.center.x - self.center.x)
        b = 2 * (other.center.y - self.center.y)
        c = (other.radius * other.radius - self.radius * self.radius +
             self.center.x * self.center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
             self.center.y * self.center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y)
        line = Line(a, b, c)
        return line.intersect_circle(self)

def find(parent, x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
        x = parent[x]
    return x

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    x = [0]*n
    y = [0]*n
    r = [0]*n
    for i in range(n):
        x[i] = next(it)
        y[i] = next(it)
        r[i] = next(it)
    circles = [Circle(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]) for i in range(n)]

    points = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i):
            intersect = circles[i].intersect(circles[j])
            if intersect is not None:
                for p in intersect:
                    points.append(p)

    bad = [False]*len(points)
    for i in range(len(points)):
        for j in range(i):
            if points[i] == points[j]:
                bad[i] = True
                break

    nVertices = sum(1 for b in bad if not b)
    parent = list(range(len(points)))
    rank = [0]*len(points)
    setCount = len(points)
    nEdges = 0

    for i in range(n):
        onThis = []
        for j in range(len(points)):
            if not bad[j] and abs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - r[i]) < epsilon:
                onThis.append(j)
        current = len(onThis)
        for j in range(1, current):
            a = find(parent, onThis[j])
            b = find(parent, onThis[0])
            if a != b:
                if rank[a] < rank[b]:
                    a, b = b, a
                elif rank[a] == rank[b]:
                    rank[a] += 1
                parent[b] = a
                setCount -= 1
        nEdges += max(current, 1)

    nComponents = setCount
    for b in bad:
        if b:
            nComponents -= 1

    result = 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
